༄༅/ /ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung glegs bam bzhi'i dkar chag bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung glegs bam bzhi'i dkar chag bzhugs so//

001 (ka)thog mar lam 'bras gsol 'debs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma spyi la bstod pa/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan la bstod pa lnga/ grub chen buddha shrī la bstod pa/ sa bzang 'phags pa la bstod pa/ bkra shis rin chen la bstod pa/ lo chen la bstod pa/ sdom gsum bla ma brgyud pa la phyag 'tshal ba/ rje sa chen la bstod pa/ lam zab brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ lam 'bras bsam mi khyab/ lhan cig skyes grub/ mchod rten drung thob/ yi ge med pa/ padma pa'i lam/ gtum mo lam rdzogs/ yon po bsrang ba/ ind+ra bhū ti'i lam/ ma (ka) hā mā yā'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ bde mchog rim lnga'i brgyud 'debs/ rtsa dbu ma'i ring brgyud/ rtsa dbu ma'i nye brgyud/ bde mchog dkar po/ gsang (kha) 'dus rim lnga 'gos lugs/ rwa rtse sems 'dzin/ shin tu spros med/ spyod 'jug zhen pa bzhi bral de rnams kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor bcas bzhugs/ 002 (ka)rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ shes phyin dkar mo/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor/ 'dod rgyal/ tshogs bdag gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ nor rgyun ma'i dkyil 'khor/ sa skya pa'i bka' srung rnams la bstod pa/ yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga bcas bzhugs/ 003 (ka)sa skya paṇḍi ta'i rnam thar/ grub chen buddha shrī'i rnam thar/ 004 (ka)sa bzang 'phags pa'i rnam thar/ 005 (ka)gsan yig chen mo/ 006 (ka)lam 'bras chos 'byung rtsom 'phro/ bshad thabs gsang ba'i sgo 'byed/ dbang bzhi'i rtogs bskyed/ mngon rtogs tshul bcu bzhi'i sdom tshig phyi nang gi bskyed rim dbang dang bcas pa'i sdom tshig nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bir srung bar chad kun sel/ sku'i rnam 'gyur drug gi zin bris/ thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs bya tshul/ yang de'i nyams len/ yang de dang lam 'bras mtshan mtshon sbyor ba/ yang bir srung gsar ma bcas bzhugs/ 007 (ka)lus dkyil rtsod spong che chung gnyis/

rgyud gsum gnod 'joms kyi bstan bcos/ rgyud gsum gnod 'joms rtsa 'grel/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gis mtshams bshad pa rnams bzhugs/ 008 (kha)bskyed rim gnad kyi zla zer/ 009 (kha)kye rdo rje rgyud gyi byung tshul dang bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ brtag gnyis kyi 'gyur chad/ brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa'i dkar chag kye rdo rje ḍombi lugs kyis sgrub thabs/ phrin yig dbang po'i rdo rje/ gzhal yas khang gi tshad rnam par gzhag pa/ 'phar ma gnyis kyi don bshad pa/ mtsho skyes dang ḍombi lugs gnyis kyi tho yig gzhal yas khang gi tshad lhag po gcig sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyi bsdus don/ bstod pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa/ mtsho skyes lugs kyi maṇḍal mchod chog bcas bzhugs/ 010 (kha)gtor chog gi 'grel pa phrin las rgyas byed/ 'dod rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/ shes phyin dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ gur rigs bsdus kyi sbyin sreg gar gyi shan 'byed/ sangs rgyas kyi gar/ phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma gtong thabs/ chos skyong gi man ngag rnams kyi dkar chag mgon po'i sgrub thabs rgyud 'grel las byung ba/ man ngag gur rgyan las byung ba/ lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang*/ gtor chog dgra las rnam rgyal/ gtor sgrub kyi man ngag thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga kye rdo rje lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs bcas bzhugs/ 011 (kha)sambu ṭa rdor dbyings kyi sgrub thabs/ gtor chog mchod phreng*/ dkyil chog sbyin sreg bkra shis rnams bzhugs/ 012 (ga)mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sgrub thabs/ sngags phreng mtshan ma/ mchod chog dkyil chog yon tan rin po che'i mdzod/ tshogs 'khor gsung ba kun rgyan/ tshogs 'khor kun bzang rnam rol bcas bzhugs/ 013 (ga)bde mchog bla ma mchod chog bde mchog gi pho brang gi rnam gzhag ril bu la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/

bde mchog dkar po'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs kyi cho ga dang bcas pa/ rdo rje lha mo'i tshe sgrub/ lha bcu gsum gyi mngon rtogs la dgos pa'i zin bris/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs dang nag po pa'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg bcas bzhugs/ 014 (ga)gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i sgrub thabs/ shin tu rnal 'byor gyi khyad par/ gtor chog mchod sprin/ rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog dkyil chog sbyin sreg rab gnas bcas bzhugs/ 015 (ga)rdo rje phreng ba'i sa bzung ba'i cho ga dgra nag gi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i char 'bebs/ 'jigs byed kyi gtor chog 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ de dag la tshang ba/ sgrub thabs kyi lung sbyor/ dkyil chog spros med mdzes rgyan/ 'di man chad gsan yig la med/ rgyud gsum lam gyi rim pa'i bsdus don/ dbang gi rim pa rab tu gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me/ gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid yig rdo rje phreng ba'i lugs kyi thig rtsa/ bla ma dge bzang ba'i dris lan rnams bzhugs/ 016 (a)dpal kun rig dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs/ gzhan phan mtha' yas/ rdul mtshon kha skong*/ cha gsum gtor ma/ dkyil 'khor sgo sbrag gi bshad pa bcas bzhugs/ 017 (a)spyod rgyud spyi'i rnam bzhag bya rgyud spyi'i rnam bshad/ 018 (a)mi 'khrugs pa'i sgo nas gshin po rjes 'dzin/ dri med lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sgrub thabs/ 'od zer dri med kyi dkyil chog a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang*/ 'od dpag med kyi tshe sgrub/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ sna tshogs yum gyi sgrub thabs/ rma bya chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ so sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs/ rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ sman bla'i mchod chog sems skyed rang gis blang pa'i cho ga gso sbyong rang gis blang pa'i cho ga mchod sbyin chen po'i zin bris/

gtor chen gyi lhan thabs/ gser sku rdo rje 'chang bzhengs tshul/ gnod sbyin gyi 'khor lo'i sngags la zhus dag mdzad pa/ rags sdom bcu'i 'bru 'grel/ bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi dkar chag bstan 'gyur dkar chag rdo rje theg pa'i bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi dkar chag thub bstan rgyas pa'i nyi 'od/ rje btsun gong ma gsum gyi bka' 'bum gyi dkar chag bcas bzhugs/ 019 (a)rang gi grwa pa spyi la gdams pa/ sa bzang bsod nams dpal gyi dris lan/ lotstsha ba rdo rje dpal/ dge 'dun mgon/ a mo gha/ chen po chos rin/ gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ bsam 'grub rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsam bzang*/ dbu ma pa shes rab rgya mtsho de rnams kyi dris lan/ ratna shrī la springs pa/ gsang sngags pa kun dga' gzhon nu la springs pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la springs pa gnyis/ bsod nams rin chen la springs pa shlau ka gcig rgyal rong pa bkra shis dpal/ sgrub pa po blo bzang la/ nyag re sangs rgyas grags/ dbon po rgyal mtshan dpal yum sras/ ya tshe rgyal po hasti rā dza yab yum sras bcas/ de'i blon po la/ thar pa ye shes te de rnams la gdams pa re re/ slob dpon bzod pa la bstod pa/ phyi'i gtam/ nang gi yas gtam/ gser 'od dam pa las btus pa'i smon lam/ dril bu pa'i lus dkyil gyi 'di gsan yig la med/ bshad pa rnams bzhugs// //dge'o// // ༈ 'di bzhin bder gshegs bka' drin gsum ldan gyi rtsa bla gsang chen slob bshad mdzod 'dzin drang srong chen po 7lce btsun 7bco brgyad 7khri chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang mkhyen rab legs bshad rgya mtsho mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched dang*/ 7dpal sa skya pa chen po 'khon brgyud kyi bka' drin bsam bzhin du/ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus sor phyag bcas phul bas dge ba gang thob 'brel tshad don ldan du 'gyur ba'i rgyu ru bsngo'o/// /dge'o//
